description: Fetch a single Vooks title by its slug, including the publisher's full description, age band, Lexile measure, running time and topics. Reads the live catalog rather than the search index, so it is never a snapshot. Use it after search_titles when you need to say more about one book than the search result carries.

slug.description: The title's slug, as returned by search_titles, for example 10-little-fish.

name: get_title

age_range.description: The same band parsed into numbers.

summary.description: A sentence or two about the book.

title: Get one Vooks title
